notes: Only the minimal Core is stable. Release 0.4.0 is the MEASURED verification-loop architecture. Quality comes from a harness-authored, digest-frozen check suite (acceptance, behavioural differential against a pre-change baseline, deterministic repo-wide symbol sweep, property checks over real data, ingested verifier findings) that the harness executes and the completion gate re-runs itself; agent self-attestation never completes a task. Measured on a shadow-replay of a real shipped fix (medi-ny NYRx parser rework), 3 trials/arm: the lean loop scored 100/100/100 versus an unscaffolded control's 77/77/77; guided feedback alone reached 100 at 2-4x tokens. Prompt scaffolding was measured as pure overhead across six fixtures (4-10.7x cost, no lift) and removed: the five-level ladder became three modes (lite/standard/critical, consequence-gated), and the impact-map and adversarial-threat-model forms are deleted. Release 0.4.0 additionally makes evidence HARNESS-GENERATED (the gate writes verification evidence from its own re-run; agents no longer transcribe it) and attaches guidance to FAILING checks rather than to prompts (just-in-time retrieval). Benchmark verdicts require >=3 trials/arm (~16pt same-arm variance measured). See Setup/adaptive-modes.md and Setup/benchmarking/verification-loop-results.md. The classic router (Router/catalog/modules.json + tools/route.ps1 default path) is unchanged; the adaptive layer stays additive and opt-in via tools/route.ps1 -Adaptive. Runtime/releases/0.4.0/promotion-record.json is the authoritative promotion timestamp and approver.
